title: Slapping the bass versus snapping the strings
summary: Foster explains how often he slaps, how he lets the string ring, and chat about a recent set.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: I was going to ask a little bit more about slapping the bass, since you're sort of famous for that. Is it really more that you slap at some time, or do you usually just snap at some time?
Well you, I didn't play that slap kick for you when you was in there, I forgot it.
Yeah you did on the same school marching in.

Oh yeah, but I got, yeah, yeah. Double, double up somewhere. See, but I got another way that I play, it's a tube. See, it's a kick, it lifts the band. If you blow it, it'll make you blow your head off, you know what I mean? See, but I didn't, see, because I do so much stuff, I forgets what I, the dude and things sometimes. And some people ask me, why not do it, see.
You were playing the bass hole when we walked in, you played by the next set too, in the waterfall.
I didn't see you when you were coming in.

Yeah, you didn't see us. We kept looking at you, and Muggsy saw me, and sort of Darnell, he recognized me. I used to know Darnell, a lot of us were talking with you, we kept looking into you, and you wouldn't look at that, I thought you'd see bass.

I was looking at it, I must be watching somebody. You were taking the business, you were playing. I must be watching somebody, there's their legs all up, and I'm always watching something like that. Oh, fair one? There's a chick sitting there, legs all up, right? I'm playing. I'm playing. I'm playing.
I'm playing. Anyway, we heard you play real good. I just wondered if you're usually trying to just snap the string against the bass sometime, or do you ever actually slap it?

The only time I slap it like that, then I raise my hand up quick so you get the tone that I'm doing, when I was doing it. They're fast enough, see? I don't just pull the strings right straight out, I let them zag, that's where your tone is, see? When you do that, you get blop, blop, see? See, now you get it, see? I like for my tone to ring, see?
It does come out good, too.
